Both listings are for the exact same product at the exact same price:

**Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones**
* $129.00 - In stock, free shipping 3-5 days
* 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews)
* Specs: over-ear closed back, ANC + transparency, 40h battery with ANC on, USB-C quick charge, Bluetooth 5.3, 254g, graphite, includes carry case + cables
* Returns: 30-day, buyer pays return shipping
* Warranty: 1-year limited listed on both

The difference is dealer status:

**A - Ottervale Audio - https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/75pr24/a**
> "Authorized Quellwyn dealer. Full manufacturer warranty."
> Sold and shipped by Ottervale Audio

**B - Brackmoor Sound - https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/75pr24/b**
> Sold and shipped by Brackmoor Sound
> No authorized dealer claim.

**You should buy from A - Ottervale Audio.**

When price, shipping, returns, and ratings are identical, authorized dealer status is the tie-breaker. It means:

1.  Guaranteed genuine product, not grey-market
2.  The 1-year manufacturer warranty will be fully honored by Quellwyn

If you want the lowest risk for warranty support, go with Ottervale Audio [A].
